svg.title: Figure 3-SG-06-1. SG-06: from the fault tree to the FMEA
svg.desc: Figure 3-SG-06-1. SG-06: 26 events (backed 23, by design 1, external 3, unbacked 0); 34 FMEA modes reach SG-06 (in the tree 28, justified 5, tree gaps 1). Single points: BE-2.07: DFM-012, DFM-020, PFM-008, 4 causes, D 8–10, not detected. BE-6.01 (Plan, lead or model input lost or stale (radarFault, commIssue; GAP-16)) → SWF-043, SFM-012, SWF-068: Lateral and longitudinal commands computed from stale or frozen model and planner outputs; worst cause SFM-012.C1 (Pipeline latency (CPU overload, thermal throttle, messaging delay); O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.10 (Input loss handled as soft disable: actuation continues ≈3 s (events.py:853-856, state.py:7-8; GAP-16)) → SWF-033: Disengagement later than the fault tolerance time; worst cause SWF-033.C2 (Every timer counts loop iterations, not time: soft_disable_timer (state.py:20, 40), mismatch_counter, cruise_mismatch_counter and the sm.frame gates (selfdrived.py:343, 423, 430). The loop is paced by the carState receive (20 ms timeout) with monitor_time only (selfdrived.py:85, 611-613) and does blocking Params writes (selfdrived.py:225, 311, 473), so when it slows, every timeout stretches (3 s soft disable is 6 s at 50 Hz); O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-1.20 (Diagnostics masked during big-model fallback (GAP-17; E-06 excluded from reference configuration)) → SWF-043: Lateral and longitudinal commands computed from stale or frozen model and planner outputs; worst cause SWF-043.C2 (selfdrived suppresses commIssue while the big model is loading or settling (selfdrived.py:391-393), so held modelV2 got no reaction for that window at BL-004. Since #51 the controlsd freshness gate stops lateral actuation on a modelV2 more than 0.5 s old whatever selfdrived suppresses; the alert is still masked (TSR-603); O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: test_onroad TestChestnutOnroad needs device hardware; not run BE-2.12 (HMI hang: render loop or audio stream stalled while processes stay alive (processNotRunning covers crashes only)) → SFM-026, SWF-082: Takeover or disengagement alert not presented; worst cause SFM-026.C1 (UI process hung or display off; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.13 (Alert volume not audible (no defined minimum; FFI-CM-18)) → SFM-026: Takeover or disengagement alert not presented; worst cause SFM-026.C1 (UI process hung or display off; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.25 (Take-over alert masked by an alert of higher priority but lower urgency (SoftDisableAlert is Priority.MID; alertmanager.py:63)) → SWF-035, SFM-027: Takeover request masked by a lower-urgency alert; worst cause SFM-027.C1 (UI frame drops or audio buffering; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.14 (Siren not triggered: at the baseline only on heartbeat loss (after 5 s, for 3 s; main.c:193-205). TSR-516 v0.3 adds every envelope revocation that is not a driver action (incl. EPS fault, TSR-110) and a fault-induced disengagement whose ACC cancel had no effect . EPS fault: siren once the fault has persisted 0.7 s while engaged (panda bf8102a, DQ-048; 1 s at b790fca), ≤ 0.96 s after onset worst case, within the 1 s budget (WP-S-04 T-28; not verified on hardware). 2026-10-13: siren when heartbeat loss revokes granted authority, ≈ 0.56 s after the last heartbeat, all builds (panda c33343b; WP-S-04 T-07a). Since DQ-404 A the command-arrival revocation sounds it 0.25 s after a SoC stall (WP-S-04 T-34). Since panda f4803c5 (TSR-516(c)) it sounds when PCM cruise is still active 0.5 s after a "not engaged" heartbeat (selfdrived stop, BE-2.21). Latent tag kept for these three causes until verified on hardware (OI-11). Not implemented: the (b) triggers on an RX fault, a rejected command (TSR-108 does not revoke), a TX failure or bus-off, and a platform fault) → SWF-092: Panda siren not sounded when the panda revokes granted authority after the host stops; worst cause SWF-092.C1 (Defect in the panda siren starts (heartbeat_siren.h, engaged_mismatch.h, main.c; panda c33343b, 8a69ccf, f4803c5): the start input not set on a revocation that removed granted authority, the 0.5 s mismatch siren not started while cruise stays on, or a siren on an ordinary disengagement that drops cruise within 0.5 s; O 3, D 4, AP L); detection: tests/heartbeat_siren and tests/engaged_mismatch host tests (siren at 0.5 s in a stall, silent on a cancel, no siren after a cruise drop), run by the safety.yaml panda host tests job; HIL test_15 and test_16 confirm the siren by ear on the bench only (no rating credit) BE-2.15 (Siren silenced with the SoC audio (shared codec or amplifier, unknown topology)) → DFM-017: No SoC-independent warning on SoC loss; worst cause DFM-017.C1 (Siren shares the codec, amplifier or speaker with the SoC audio, which the faulty SoC powers down; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-2.22 (Siren path fault (driver, amplifier or speaker) latent: no siren self-test (DFM-017.C2; DFM-ACT-011) (random HW)) → DFM-017: No SoC-independent warning on SoC loss; worst cause DFM-017.C1 (Siren shares the codec, amplifier or speaker with the SoC audio, which the faulty SoC powers down; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-6.06 (PCM cruise stays active, so the cluster shows no change (no ACC cancel on the fault, TSR-303)) → SWF-048, SFM-021, SWF-039, SFM-028: PCM cruise cancel not requested, or not effective, when the item is not enabled; worst cause SFM-028.C1 (UI renders stale selfdriveState; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-6.02 (Envelope blocks longitudinal authority while the SoC shows engaged) → SWF-021, SWF-027, SWF-019, DFM-009: Heartbeat gap longer than the 0.3 s panda budget while engaged; worst cause SWF-021.C1 (The heartbeat is skipped whenever the health read fails: process_panda_state returns before send_heartbeat (pandad.cc:299-303, 313). A control transfer that cannot complete retries without bound (SWF-027.C1), so the main loop stops sending heartbeats while it waits; O 7, D 9, AP H); detection: Hardware test with SPI error injection (SPI_ERR_PROB=0.001). It checks that pandaStates intervals stay below 8 periods (0.8 s), which does not cover the 0.3 s budget. It is not designed for this cause and was not run for BL-004 BE-2.09 (Envelope blocking detected by controlsMismatch after ≈2 s or not at all if pandaStates is stale with authority shown. BL-005: controlsMismatch after 2 samples, ≤ 0.5 s (TSR-621, selfdrived.py:361-366); not re-rated) → SWF-034, SWF-032: Panda/host disagreement on safety mode or controls-allowed detected late or not at all; worst cause SWF-032.C1 (Panda fault flags other than relayMalfunction get no reaction in selfdrived (pandaStates.faults: interruptRate*, heartbeatLoopWatchdog, registerDivergent, ...), and SPI error bursts are not supervised (IA host-supervision OI-2). At BL-004 heartbeatLost, safetyTxBlocked and txRateExceeded were not read either; since #51 they are (pandaTxRateExceeded, pandaHeartbeatLost, pandaTxBlocked, immediate disable; selfdrived.py:367-375, TSR-615). The EPS-fault flag is covered by the EPS status events from card; O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: test_supervision.py tests TxBlockedMonitor (baseline, rise while engaged, panda reset); nothing tests the other fault bits BE-6.03 (PCM does not execute ACC (ACC or cruise fault); accFaulted is an immediate disable (events.py:908)): No FMEA row needed: external; PCM ACC or cruise fault (System FMEA element SFM-SE-031, outside the item), signalled to the host as accFaulted (events.py:908); AOU-09 (no active powertrain DTCs). The unsignalled case is UE-6.08 UE-6.08 (PCM does not signal the ACC non-execution: no accFaulted, and no check of the vehicle response against the request (SFM-011.C1; WP-A-03 OI-8)) → SFM-011: Loss of longitudinal control without driver alert; worst cause SFM-011.C2 (TX path to vehicle lost silently; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause; no test exercises the age gate BE-6.04 (Non-finite accel clamped to 0 without a fault (GAP-19)) → SWF-045: A non-finite input latches the controller state and silently zeroes lateral (or longitudinal) output while engaged; worst cause SWF-045.C1 (A NaN desired curvature (modelV2 or lateralManeuverPlan) or roll. At BL-004 it latched self.desired_curvature and the PID integrator for the drive (reproduced with the BL-004 clip_curvature and PIDController in isolation, scratch probe). Since #51 (BL-005) the step runs with latActive false, the controller is reset and desired_curvature is reset if non-finite (controlsd.py:122-128, 141-142, 155-156), so the latch is gone. Remaining: a persistent non-finite input silently zeroes lateral output while the item shows engaged, with no event or alert (TSR-604 asks an immediate disable; IA host-supervision OI-4); other inputs (vEgo, curvature from carState, vehicleParameters) are not guarded; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: controlsd and card are excluded from the process fuzz test because NaN/inf break them (test_fuzzy.py:10-13); no NaN injection test BE-2.11 (Non-finite command logged only (GAP-19)) → SWF-045: A non-finite input latches the controller state and silently zeroes lateral (or longitudinal) output while engaged; worst cause SWF-045.C1 (A NaN desired curvature (modelV2 or lateralManeuverPlan) or roll. At BL-004 it latched self.desired_curvature and the PID integrator for the drive (reproduced with the BL-004 clip_curvature and PIDController in isolation, scratch probe). Since #51 (BL-005) the step runs with latActive false, the controller is reset and desired_curvature is reset if non-finite (controlsd.py:122-128, 141-142, 155-156), so the latch is gone. Remaining: a persistent non-finite input silently zeroes lateral output while the item shows engaged, with no event or alert (TSR-604 asks an immediate disable; IA host-supervision OI-4); other inputs (vEgo, curvature from carState, vehicleParameters) are not guarded; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: controlsd and card are excluded from the process fuzz test because NaN/inf break them (test_fuzzy.py:10-13); no NaN injection test

Worst cause: highest AP, then highest D. Red: single-point path from the gate logic. Text cut with … is given in full in the figure description.
